data.title: 花火 · 拉开门试试纸风车
data.description: 露天剧场的两扇布景门只拉开一条缝，风就把桌上三只纸风车吹得乱转。花火把最后一只立起来，用两根手指扶住细杆，偏过头等它追上另外几只。珊瑚红浴衣的金鱼图案和侧戴的狐面都在灯笼光里。
data.location: 游园剧场的布景门与准备桌
data.action: 把纸风车竖进穿堂风里，扶住细杆看它转起来
data.lighting: 门缝留下自然晚光，近处的灯笼照着金鱼衣纹
data.camera: 斜侧七分身，台桌向门缝延伸
data.promptProse: Sparkle props the last paper pinwheel upright on a stage table and cracks open the scenery door. A cross-breeze sets the other three spinning. The goldfish print on her coral-red cotton yukata shows beneath the lanterns, the black obi tied neatly and a fox mask set to one side of her head.
data.animaCaption: She steadies the stem with two fingers and watches the paper blades catch up with the rest.
